UNH.rationale: UNH is a fundamentally deteriorating business with severe valuation dislocation. The company's net margin has collapsed from 5.6% in mid-2025 to 2.8% currently, while ROE has fallen from 22.8% to 12.3% over the same period. The P/E has expanded from ~10x to 27x despite this margin compression, representing a massive valuation re-rating disconnected from deteriorating fundamentals. The company faces multiple structural headwinds: DOJ investigations, Medicare Advantage overbilling scrutiny, antitrust concerns, and ongoing fallout from the Change Healthcare cyberattack. Berkshire Hathaway's complete exit of its 5M share position under new CEO Greg Abel signals institutional concern about the risk/reward. The company is actively cutting 1.3 million Medicare Advantage members to protect margins, which constrains revenue growth to just 2% YoY. While Q1 2026 beat estimates, the earnings trajectory is volatile and the TTM data is incomplete due to fiscal gaps. The stock has rallied 33% in one quarter from oversold levels, but this has pushed valuation to the top of its 365-day range (P/E 27x vs range 9.5-28.5x). No near-term fundamental catalyst exists to justify current multiples given regulatory overhangs and margin pressure.
